questions.question: Which three states had the largest estimated veteran populations as of September 30, 2023?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('va_geographic_distribution_of_expenditures_fy2023.xlsx', sheet_name='State Level Expenditures', header=None)
totals_indices = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Totals'].index
states_df = df.iloc[totals_indices[0] + 1 : totals_indices[1]].copy()
states_df[1] = pd.to_numeric(states_df[1], errors='coerce')
top3 = states_df.sort_values(by=1, ascending=False).head(3)
result = top3[0].str.strip().tolist()

questions.question: In Delaware, how many unique patients received treatment at a VA health care facility in Kent County during FY 2023?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('va_geographic_distribution_of_expenditures_fy2023.xlsx', sheet_name='DE', header=None)
kent_row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip().str.upper() == 'KENT']
result = int(kent_row.iloc[0, 10])

questions.question: How many counties in Connecticut had total VA expenditures exceeding $100 million in fiscal year 2023?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('va_geographic_distribution_of_expenditures_fy2023.xlsx', sheet_name='CT', header=None)
end_idx = df[df[0].astype(str).str.contains('Totals', case=False, na=False)].index[0]
counties = df.iloc[3:end_idx].copy()
counties[2] = pd.to_numeric(counties[2], errors='coerce')
result = int((counties[2] > 100000).sum())

questions.question: Between Hawaii County and Maui County, which had more unique patients receiving VA medical care in FY 2023?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('va_geographic_distribution_of_expenditures_fy2023.xlsx', sheet_name='HI', header=None)
hawaii_val = pd.to_numeric(df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'HAWAII'].iloc[0, 10], errors='coerce')
maui_val = pd.to_numeric(df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'MAUI'].iloc[0, 10], errors='coerce')
result = 'HAWAII' if hawaii_val > maui_val else 'MAUI'

questions.question: In fiscal year 2023, did Florida have a higher number of unique patients treated at VA health care facilities than California?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('va_geographic_distribution_of_expenditures_fy2023.xlsx', sheet_name='State Level Expenditures', header=None)
fl_row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Florida']
ca_row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'California']
fl_patients = float(fl_row.iloc[0, 10])
ca_patients = float(ca_row.iloc[0, 10])
result = 'yes' if fl_patients > ca_patients else 'no'

questions.question: Which congressional district in Arkansas had the highest total VA expenditures in FY 2023?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('va_geographic_distribution_of_expenditures_fy2023.xlsx', sheet_name='AR', header=None)
cong_dist = df[df[0].astype(str).str.contains('CONG. DIST', case=False, na=False)].copy()
cong_dist[2] = pd.to_numeric(cong_dist[2], errors='coerce')
max_row = cong_dist.loc[cong_dist[2].idxmax()]
result = str(max_row[0]).strip()
